plainTranslation:
This person makes you believe you can do it. Their confidence feeds your drive. Your drive gives their optimism somewhere to go. Together, you tend to move toward things instead of talking yourselves out of them. What feels intimidating alone can feel possible together.

You bring out each other's courage. You back each other's goals, encourage each other's risks, and make it easier to trust your own abilities. There is a natural sense of momentum here. Less second-guessing. More doing.

The challenge is that things come so easily between you that you may not push yourselves to use the gift. It feels good to believe in what is possible. It is another thing to actually commit to it.

This connection offers confidence. The invitation is to do something with it. Potential is not the same as movement. Let the encouragement land. Take the step. Trust yourself enough to begin.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
